feedback.incorrect: Check the requirements and compare your code with the expected structure.

content.title: Explain the call
content.text:
Read this from the inside out:

```js
const total = add(5, 2);
```

First, `add(5, 2)` runs. Then its returned value becomes the value stored in `total`.

options.text: It gives a reusable piece of behavior a name and lets it accept inputs and return a result.
It automatically makes code run faster.

content.title: Forge takeaway & Lesson completion
takeaways: **Mental model:** A function is a named job: give it inputs, run its steps, receive a result.
**Senior habit:** Name functions after the job they perform, not the line of code they happen to contain.
nextSteps: Complete the checkpoint and explain the mechanism in your own words. A wrong first prediction is expected; the mastery signal is whether you can explain the result and handle a changed case after feedback.
